[EN] I am alive thanks to you.

Bless you. I was about to lose all hope...
[ES] Estoy vivo gracias a ti.

Que Kaia te bendiga. Estaba a punto de perder toda esperanza...

[EN] We must recover the Furnace Controller! Hurry and deliver this news!
[ES] ¡Debemos recuperar el Furnace Controller! ¡Date prisa y lleva esta noticia!

[EN] Thulsa's Legion...

The Divine Furnace...

I wonder if Muhrak is safe...
[ES] La Legión de Thulsa...

El Divine Furnace...

Me pregunto si Muhrak estará a salvo...

[EN] I am ashamed... I was too afraid of dying and didn't even put up any resistance...
[ES] Qué vergüenza tengo... Tenía tanto miedo de morir que ni siquiera opuse resistencia...

[EN] I don't want to die like this. Help!
[ES] No quiero morir así. ¡Ayuda!
